ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels. High-intensity pixels are concentrated on the distal one-third of each lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal regions of both left and right lobes contain large, contiguous white geometric blobs. The central fluke area (surrounding the notch and peduncle) consists of a solid black low-intensity region with scattered high-intensity pixel points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a clearly defined apex; pixel depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the full trailing edge. Distinct jagged peaks are observed on the inner-half of the right lobe and throughout the left lobe trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of approximately 10-15 roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups on the superior-lateral edge of the left lobe. Multiple single-pixel white spots scattered across the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, near-vertical black linear scar is visible within the white patch on the right lobe. A faint, thin diagonal linear mark is detected in the center-right black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear trauma/scar on the right lobe; white pigmentation on distal lobes suggests significant past interaction or scarring; calcareous-like clusters (barnacles) visible on the extreme lateral tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast vertical line segmentation within the right-side white pigmentation field.
